subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Defile
solution: The correct answer is** "Clean".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Defile **means to make something dirty or impure. (किसी चीज़ को गंदा या अशुद्ध करना) • **Clean** is the opposite of defile, meaning to make something free from dirt or impurities. (किसी चीज़ को गंदगी या अशुद्धियों से मुक्त करना) • Tarnish and befoul are synonyms of defile, meaning to make something dirty or stain it. Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Tarnish **means to make something lose its shine or luster, often due to corrosion or age. (किसी चीज़ की चमक या चमक खोना, अक्सर जंग या उम्र के कारण) • **Befoul **means to make something dirty or foul-smelling, often due to pollution or waste. (अक्सर प्रदूषण या कचरे के कारण किसी चीज़ को गंदा या दुर्गंधयुक्त बनाना) • **Corrupt **means to make something immoral or dishonest, often due to greed or power. (अक्सर लालच या शक्ति के कारण कुछ अनैतिक या बेईमान बनाना) 5f:T9fb, The correct answer is **"My grandfather advised me to respect the national flag always." **
